name: Muhammad XI of Granada
role: Ruler of the Emirate of Grenada
contribution: The 22nd and last Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada in Iberia.

checks.lead: Abu Abdallah Muhammad XI (Arabic: أبو عبد الله محمد الثاني عشر, romanized: Abū ʿAbdi-llāh Muḥammad ath-thānī ʿashar; c. 1460–1533), known in Europe as Boabdil, was the 22nd and last Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada in Iberia.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
